title: Binance Futures Will Launch Multiple BUSD-Margined Perpetual Contracts with Up to 20X Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch multiple BUSD-margined perpetual contracts with up to 20x leverage according to the table below: BUSD-Margined Perpetual Contracts DOTBUSD TLMBUSD ICPBUSD Launch Time 2022-06-08 02:45 AM (UTC) 2022-06-09 02:45 AM (UTC) 2022-06-09 03:00 AM (UTC) Settlement Asset BUSD BUSD BUSD Face Value 1 DOT 1 TLM 1 ICP Tick Size 0.001 0.00001 0.001 Capped Funding Rate Clamp (Funding Rate, -0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio, 0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio) Clamp (Funding Rate, -0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio, 0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio) Clamp (Funding Rate, -0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio, 0.75 * Maintenance Margin Ratio) Max Leverage 20x 20x 20x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 24/7 Multi-Asset Mode Supported Supported Supported Please note: DOTBUSD, TLMBUSD and ICPBUSD perpetual contracts are BUSD-margined futures contracts that use BUSD as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-20x leverage. Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the settings of these contracts from time to time. The  Multi-Asset Mode  allows users to trade USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts across multiple margin assets. Users can use USDT as margin when trading BUSD-margined perpetual contracts.
